sources.reference: User-supplied cockpit and empty-hull photos, 2026-10-07: light cream/white gelcoat, rounded raised cockpit lip, moulded non-slip, two long grey/dark side grip strips, lifted central padded webbing, daggerboard fittings and stern details. Photos describe appearance and arrangement, not calibrated dimensions. No brands or copied sail markings.
sources.dimensions: VISUAL ESTIMATE: every dimension and placement offset in this file, including lip cross-section, floor fillet, gunwale bead, rails, screw placement, webbing and padding, anchors, daggerboard collar/handle/elastic, inspection cap and stern bung. All geometry is render-only; the existing hull sections, cockpit layout, daggerboard position, controls and physics remain unchanged.
sources.surface: TUNING GUESS: warm-white colours, matte roughness, 12 mm low-contrast mould pitch, 1.5 mm bump strength, texture resolutions, mask feather, anisotropy and tessellation. Non-slip uses a 0.96 linear-light tone with 0.018 mould contrast, leaving smooth margins unmodulated; this is shallow cream/grey mould relief, not dirt or speckled pigment. Red relief, green roughness and blue tone are baked into the same per-boat mipmapped texture. A focused material shader patch reuses the existing roughness texture sample for blue-channel diffuse modulation without another sampler/fetch. Smooth margins are part of the same UV/material surface, not overlapping geometry. These are visual screen-space estimates rather than a material specification.
